query: SELECT COUNT(*) as orphaned_3m FROM collection_manual_ticks cmt LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = cmt.receivable_id WHERE ar.id IS NULL AND cmt.receivable_id BETWEEN 3000000 AND 4000000;
